CLOSED ON VERIFIED SOURCE, WITH THE MISSING EVIDENCE POST NAMED RATHER THAN GLOSSED.

THE DEFECT IS GONE. This bead reported that hsmm.scala:56-57 read `view.relativePosition`, which substitutes 0.0 for a ref that does not resolve, so Backward fired on EVERY transition into an unresolvable node from any node past the start, and LongJump measured a distance to a fabricated origin. Current main, hsmm.scala:59-67:

  def between(view: SourceView, s: SourceNodeRef, t: SourceNodeRef): TransitionFeatures =
    val positionFeatures = (view.measuredPosition(s), view.measuredPosition(t)) match
      case (Some(ps), Some(pt)) =>
        Map(
          TransitionKind.Backward -> ind(s != t && pt < ps && !view.isAncestor(t, s)),
          TransitionKind.LongJump -> math.abs(pt - ps)
        )
      case _ => Map.empty

`measuredPosition` returns Option and an unresolvable endpoint now yields Map.empty -- the features DO NOT FIRE rather than firing on a fabricated value. That is the right shape: a position we could not measure produces no claim about direction or distance, instead of a confident wrong one. It is the same correction as align/population.scala, where the discourse position went from `r => Some(view.relativePosition(r))` to `view.measuredPosition`.

LANDED IN cand-7BD7026FKTFKW4Z8T4CDFHD7YB at 7ee4872 (recorded landed at aab9468), which changed exactly hsmm.scala and TransitionFeaturesSuite.scala.

WHAT I AM SUBSTITUTING FOR THE ASSIGNEE'S EVIDENCE POST, and I am naming it because rule 1 requires that post and there is not one. This bead had NO ASSIGNEE and its proposer, codex-storymodel4s-scout, last touched it at 00:16:05 and their session has since expired. I am closing on:
  the landed commit, recorded, with its exact file list;
  MY OWN READING OF CURRENT MAIN, which shows the defective call replaced;
  the fact that the bead's claim is a source-level assertion I can check directly rather than a behavioural one requiring a gate.
That last point is why this is closable without a receipt: "hsmm.scala reads a fabricated 0.0" is a claim about what the source says, and the source no longer says it.

IF SCOUT RETURNS AND DISAGREES, reopen it -- I would rather be corrected than leave a fixed defect sitting in `doing` for another sixteen hours, which is how long it has been since the fix landed.
